meals.title: Braai Pork Chops with Pineapple-Chutney Glaze and Foil Potatoes
meals.why: PnP pork braai chops, a Queen pineapple and 2kg of potatoes are all on special this week, so the whole braai comes from one store.
method: Light the fire. Cut the potatoes into chunks, toss with oil, salt and butter, wrap in foil parcels and place on the coals for 35-40 minutes.
Mix 3 tbsp chutney with a little oil, crushed garlic and pepper. Coat the pork chops and leave them for 15 minutes.
Peel the pineapple, cut into thick rings and brush with a little chutney.
Braai the chops over medium coals for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through. Braai the pineapple rings for 2-3 minutes per side until caramelised.
Serve the chops with the potatoes, pineapple and a green salad.

meals.title: Butternut and Tomato Curry with Rice
meals.why: Butternut is only R14.99/kg at Checkers and bulks out a vegetarian curry, which is served with cheap parboiled rice.
method: Fry a chopped onion and garlic in oil until soft, then add 2 tbsp curry powder and the tomato paste and stir for 1 minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes, about 1 cup of water and the peeled, cubed butternut. Simmer for 20-25 minutes until tender.
Add the drained chickpeas and cook for 5 minutes more. Season with salt.
Cook the rice according to the packet.
Serve the curry over the rice with a dollop of plain yoghurt.

meals.title: Mi Goreng with Fried Eggs and Veg
meals.why: Indomie is under R6 a packet and a tray of Nulaid eggs adds protein, so dinner costs very little per person.

uses.item: Indomie Mi Goreng Fried Instant Noodles 85g

method: Boil the noodles for about 3 minutes, then drain, keeping 2 tbsp of the water.
Stir-fry the shredded cabbage or frozen veg in a hot pan for 3-4 minutes.
Toss the noodles through the veg with the seasoning sachets, reserved water and a splash of soy sauce.
Fry one egg per person in a separate pan until the whites are crisp and the yolks still runny.
Top each bowl with an egg and sliced spring onion.

meals.title: Beef Mince and Macaroni Oven Bake
meals.why: Checkers lean mince, cheap macaroni and a R5 tomato paste sachet make a tray that feeds a family and gives you leftovers for lunch.
method: Brown 500g mince with a chopped onion and garlic. Add the chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, herbs and seasoning, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Boil the macaroni for 2 minutes less than the packet says, then drain.
Make a white sauce: melt 2 tbsp butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour, then slowly whisk in 2 cups milk until thick. Stir in half the cheese.
Mix the macaroni into the mince and pour into an ovenproof dish. Top with the white sauce and the remaining cheese.
Bake at 180°C for 30-35 minutes until golden and bubbling.

meals.title: Peri-Peri Chicken Livers on Rice
meals.why: A 500g pack of frozen chicken livers is only R21.50, which makes this one of the cheapest proteins on special.
method: Thaw the livers, pat them dry and trim any sinew.
Start the rice cooking.
Fry the onion and garlic in oil. Add the livers and sear for 3-4 minutes until browned.
Stir in the tomato paste, chopped tomatoes and peri-peri spice, then simmer for 8-10 minutes until the sauce thickens and the livers are just cooked through.
Serve over the rice with fresh herbs.

meals.title: Potato, Egg and Smoked Cheese Tortilla
meals.why: Potatoes, eggs and the PnP smoked cheese griller are all on special this week, so this vegetarian dinner needs hardly anything else.
method: Slice about 600g potatoes thinly and fry with a sliced onion in oil over medium heat for 12-15 minutes until soft.
Beat 6 eggs with salt and pepper and stir in half the cubed smoked cheese.
Pour the egg mix over the potatoes in the pan, cover and cook on low for 8-10 minutes until mostly set.
Top with the remaining cheese and grill for 3-4 minutes until golden.
Cut into wedges and serve with a yoghurt dollop and a side salad.
